title: Swadeshi Movement And Associated Leaders
definition: The Swadeshi Movement (1905-1908) was the first major mass movement in modern India, triggered by the Partition of Bengal, aimed at economic self-reliance (Swadeshi) and political autonomy (Swaraj) through the boycott of British goods.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the transition from 'Moderate' to 'Extremist' politics, introduces mass mobilization techniques, and serves as a precursor to the Gandhian era of non-cooperation.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Swadeshi Movement And Associated Leaders.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
